correctness.rationale: FAIL: the shipped proof chain does not close as a rigorous proof. Verified exactly and independently: F/S matrices from Gaussian moments, P=S-F^2 spectrum {0,1,1,4/3,5/3}, ||A||<=1/2 by AM-GM giving equivalence [0.9375,1.0625], joint Gram J (found rank-8 singular since u_1==w_0 micro, so the stated J^{-1} constraint as written is ill-posed and only the regularized superset argument saves sufficiency), and float PSD of G_28 (min eig 0.007787, residuals ~1e-15). But (i) both shipped verify scripts begin exec(open('scratch/lmi15.py')...) and that file is absent from inputs/artifacts, so the documented reproduction cannot run and the F/S/B/J reconstruction plus K-block derivation (complex skew terms) cannot be checked from the package; (ii) the LMI 'certificate' is plain floating-point eigendecomposition with no interval/rational enclosure, i.e. experimental evidence, while DRAFT Step 3 overstates it as certifying lambda_min>=0.007787. Independent exact-restriction Galerkin checks (degrees<=6, Qmax=-0.02236) support truth but do not repair the shipped proof gap.

Nearest priors -- DMS 2009 linear-relaxation note (whose headline illustration IS the BGK model), DMS 2015 mass-conservation paper, Arnold-Dolbeault-Schmeiser-Woehrer Fourier sharpening, and multi-D BGK entropy-functional literature -- state twisting parameters symbolically/existentially or use different functionals, and none logs this per-mode pair; synonymous phrasings (mode-wise Lyapunov, micro-macro dissipation) and table/database searches reveal no covering entry. Prior work does not mechanically imply these exact numbers without the fresh matrix computation, so the instance is new and not a corollary. Emergent-route genuineness verified: same fiber, same functional form, same admitted numbers as the hard-sphere target, with the target-exit documenting the quantified HS block (Baranger-Mouhot gap 0.0281 vs cross-term demand, failing HS LMI scans).

value.rationale: FAIL: new but not independently worth retrieving; judged with no preset-value presumption as required for EMERGENT_FINDING. The conceptual content -- DMS twisted-L2 hypocoercivity of the linearized BGK relaxation operator -- is textbook (it is the headline illustration of DMS 2009, arXiv:0810.3493), and the submission only fills the hard-sphere target's leftover numbers (eps=1/8, kappa=1/120) into that known framework at one mode. The concluded bound dH/dt<=-(1/120)||micro||^2 is micro-only (no macroscopic coercivity, implies no decay by itself) and 120x lossy against the unit BGK micro gap, with constants arbitrary from any BGK perspective. No benchmark, classification boundary, sharpness, or downstream BGK use is demonstrated; the claimed bottleneck-direction and LMI-template significance points to future hard-sphere work, i.e. a new research direction, which cannot carry an emergent finding's value. This is a textbook restatement plus arbitrary parameter fact, explicitly rejected by the shared standard even when correct and new.
